title: Item:Eberron Dragonshard
wikitext:
__TOC__ '''Eberron Dragonshard Fragments''' are relatively rare collectables that have a 1% chance of being randomly found in any collectable node throughout the game, including piles of rubble, mushrooms, alchemy tables, etc., and a smaller chance of being found in [[Treasure Bag]]s. They can be turned in to certain collectors for powerful items, or traded with Crafting Hall vendors for [[Purified Eberron Dragonshard Fragment]]s used in high-level [[Essence Crafting]]. The exchange for [[Purified Eberron Dragonshard Fragment]]s is 1:1 for Small Eberron Dragonshard Fragments, 2:1 for Medium Eberron Dragonshard Fragments, and 3:1 for Large Eberron Dragonshard Fragments. {{clear}} == [[File:SmallEberronDragonshardFragmentIcon.png|32px|frameless|left]]Small Eberron Dragonshard Fragment == [[File:SmallEberronDragonshardFragmentDesc.png|right|width=300]]A small sliver-like fragment of a dark colored Eberron Dragonshard. These fragments would be extremely valuable to the right person. Seek out Collectors in [[the Marketplace]]. Three Small Eberron Dragonshard Fragments can be turned into: * '''[[Xovun Chalk]]''' in [[the Marketplace]] for a [[Medium Experience Elixir]] (ML 1, {{Bind|BtA|BoA}}, 10% bonus to XP for 6 hours) ''Note: Dialog states "Lesser", but a Medium is given.'' * '''[[Peta Flashpin]]''' in [[the Marketplace]] for a [[Rest of the Eladrin Statuette]] (ML 1, {{Bind|BtA|BoA}}, allows your character to rest once anywhere in any non-raid quest) * '''[[Rudolf Rightman]]''' in [[the Marketplace]] for a [[Small Shard Trinket]] of 20x [[Cure Serious Wounds]] (No ML, {{Bind|BtC|BoA}}, [[Exclusive]]) {{clear}} == [[File:MediumEberronDragonshardFragmentIcon.png|32px|frameless|left]]Medium Eberron Dragonshard Fragment == [[File:MediumEberronDragonshardFragmentDesc.png|right|width=300]] A medium sliver-like fragment of a dark colored Eberron Dragonshard. These fragments would be extremely valuable to the right person. Seek out Collectors in the [[Marketplace]], and [[House Deneith]]. Three Medium Eberron Dragonshard Fragment can be turned in to:
Marketplace Collectors * '''[[Clarice Roden]]''' gives a [[Shard Trinket of Greater Restoration]] (20 Charges, No ML, {{Bind|BtC|BoA}}, [[Exclusive]]) * '''[[Loura Jotun]]''' gives a [[Shard Trinket of Mass Hold Person]] (10 Charges, CL 15, No ML, {{Bind|BtC|BoA}}, [[Exclusive]]) * '''[[Kipling Vranch]]''' gives a [[Shard Trinket of Mass Protection Elements]] (20 Charges, CL 15, No ML, {{Bind|BtC|BoA}}, [[Exclusive]]) * '''[[Davyd Turner]]''' gives a [[Shard Trinket of Mnemonic Enhancement]] (20 Charges, No ML, {{Bind|BtC|BoA}}, [[Exclusive]]) * '''[[Yannick Drumdoom]]''' gives a [[Shard Trinket of Summon Monster VII]] (20 Charges, No ML, {{Bind|BtC|BoA}}, [[Exclusive]]) House Deneith Collectors * '''[[Chirugeon Laj'amal]]''' gives a [[Medium Shard Trinket]] (Mass [[Cure Critical Wounds]]) (20 Charges, CL 16, No ML, {{Bind|BtC|BoA}}, [[Exclusive]]) * '''[[Tara Wightraven]]''' gives a [[Major Experience Elixir]] (20% bonus to XP for 6 hours, (No ML, {{Bind|BtA|BoA}}.) ''Note: Dialog states greater, but a major is given.'' * '''[[Flintchip Fireson]]''' gives a [[Shard Trinket of Sunburst]] (20 Charges, CL 13, No ML, {{Bind|BtC|BoA}}, [[Exclusive]]) : '''Warning''': You can only have one of each of the [[Exclusive]] rewards in your inventory at a time; if you already have one, the vendor will accept your Medium Eberron Dragonshard Fragments and give you nothing but an error popup in return. {{clear}} == [[File:LargeEberronDragonshardFragmentIcon.png|32px|frameless|left]]Large Eberron Dragonshard Fragment == [[File:LargeEberronDragonshardFragmentDesc.png|right|width=300]]A large sliver-like fragment of a dark colored Eberron Dragonshard. These fragments would be extremely valuable to the right person. Seek out Collectors in [[House Phiarlan]]. Three Large Eberron Dragonshard Fragment can be turned into: * '''[[Seld the Gray Sister]]''' gives an [[Ethereal Rest Shrine]] (ML 1, {{Bind|BtA|BoA}}, stacks up to 10 in inventory, not usable in Raids) * '''[[Bowdlin]]''' gives a [[Item:Treasure_Hunter's_Elixir#Lesser_Treasure_Hunter.27s_Elixir|Lesser Treasure Hunter's Elixir]] * '''[[Kayla Skywhisper]]''' gives a [[Kohl's Gem]] (just a gem to sell for platinum; don't get this, you make more selling the 3 Large Eberron Dragonshard Fragments to other players) {{clear}} === Notes === * Each reward except exchanging for [[Purified Eberron Dragonshard Fragment]]s requires that you turn in three fragments. * The rewards are either bound to account or bound to character on acquire * The reward trinkets have a limited number of use. They are not rechargeable. == Number series puzzle == When a set of Dragonshards is turned in, the collector will offer a riddle for an additional reward, referent to the first turn in they have, so +3 Robe for Xovun Chalk etcetera. Be warned, as there is an estimated three-minute timer in these puzzles. Failing to complete it in time results in no additional reward, but you keep what you were given before. {{:Eberron Dragonshard/Number series puzzle}} {{*}} see also {{Forums|224313|Number series puzzle thread|archive=20250803112853}} {| width="96%" align="center" |- align="center" | style="vertical-align: middle" width="48%" | [[File:Dragonshard1.jpg|frameless|340px|Collector UI]] || style="vertical-align: middle" width="48%" | [[File:Dragonshard2.jpg|frameless|340px|Reward item]] |- align="center" | style="vertical-align: middle" | [[File:Dragonshard3.jpg|frameless|340px|The Riddle]] || style="vertical-align: middle" | [[File:Dragonshard4.jpg|frameless|340px|Additional reward]] |} [[Category:Collectables]] [[Category:Dragonshards]]
